question: A magnetic material is placed in an external magnetising field $\vec{H}$. Explain the meaning of magnetisation $\vec{M}$ and obtain its relation with magnetic susceptibility $\chi$.

options.A: Magnetisation $\vec M$ is the magnetic moment per unit volume of the material: $\vec M=\dfrac{\vec m_{\text{net}}}{V}$. For a linear magnetic material, $\vec M=\chi\vec H$.
options.B: Magnetisation is the magnetic flux per unit area, and for a linear material $\vec M=\dfrac{\vec H}{\chi}$.
options.C: Magnetisation is the force on a magnetic pole, and its relation with susceptibility is $\vec M=\chi/\vec H$.
options.D: Magnetisation is independent of the magnetising field, so $\vec M=\vec H+\chi$.
